messages:
sara: Planning a short prod push in ~60m to ship v2.18.1 (perf hotfix). Change window is 23:00-00:00 PT. Who's available to press? Need MFA + prod-deployer role.
jamie: I can be on standby but I'm not in prod-deployer role atm. Need JIT.
mike: Heads up: release-signer (pgp) is out tonight. We need someone who can sign and press. @ops-sre can you advise?
ops-sre: We can grant temporary elevation; must be approved by a second approver. @alex are you good to approve?
alex: I can approve. Jamie, once you confirm, I'll sign off. Ping me when you request.
jamie: Requesting elevation now: `grant-elev --user jamie --role prod-deployer --duration 40m --reason 'midnight hotfix'`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Elevation request received for @jamie. Approval required from @alex.
alex: Approved. MFA check passed? Did you enroll device, @jamie?
jamie: Yes, just completed MFA push. Verified with `auth verify --u jamie` :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Elevation granted to @jamie until 00:20 PT. Role: prod-deployer. Actions will be audited.
sara: Thanks. @jamie when you press, follow the runbook: `./scripts/release.sh v2.18.1 --dry-run` then `./scripts/release.sh v2.18.1 --go` if logs look ok.
jamie: Starting dry-run now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Dry-run logs: all checks passed. Estimated rollout time 4m.
jamie: Going live in 30s.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started by @jamie. Target: prod cluster us-west-2. ID: deploy_20240318_5387654321
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Alert subscription: increase in 5xx rates if >0.5% for 2m.
mike: :eyes: watching metrics.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Step 3/5 failed: canary 1 -> 5xx spike at 00:10 PT. Rolling back canary.
jamie: Seeing the same in Dashboards. CPU spike and request errors.
sara: Pause full rollout. Agree rollback to pinned baseline v2.17.9.
alex: Confirm rollback. @jamie please run rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback deploy_20240318_5387654321 --to v2.17.9`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @jamie. Reason: canary 5xx spike.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Service restored to v2.17.9. Postmortem required? :question:
jamie: Creating short postmortem doc. Notes: investigate KV cache change in hotfix that may cause regression.
sara: Thanks all. Closing change window early. Ops: please flag any follow-ups and re-schedule patch for next week with more canary steps. :thumbsup:
